nodes.name: Calculate Bounce/Complaint Rates
nodes.notes: ⚠️ ASSUMED thresholds (industry-standard, not in KB): bounce rate > 5% or complaint rate > 0.1% triggers alert. Adjust per Nivy's actual risk tolerance.

value.payload: ={{ { bounce_rate_pct: $json.bounce_rate_pct, complaint_rate_pct: $json.complaint_rate_pct, sent: $json.sent, bounced: $json.bounced, complaints: $json.complaints, alerted_at: $now.toISO() } }}

nodes.name: Report to Hub - Deliverability Alert
nodes.notes: S6.11: fires only on the over-threshold (IF-true) branch. This is also the audit's §2.1/§3.4 unwired-branch fix -- previously this alert only reached Odoo Discuss and went nowhere else in the system; the Hub report-out is what wires it into the rest of the funnel. client_id is null since this is an account-wide (not per-client) alert -- payload carries the rates instead.
